name: Ride909
description: Techno 909 ride wash on off-beats 3-7-11-15 with kick sidechain pump on 1-5-9-13. Hold pad to play. Sound is 6-bit Ride ROM through variable-rate playback, resistor DAC, and analog reconstruction. X = Tune, Y = pump, Depth = mix.

params.name: PITCH
params.detail: 909 Tune: ROM clock rate, decay tracks pitch

params.name: PUMP
params.detail: Kick sidechain amount (bottom = off, top = deep)
